en.title: 9 PS Plus Games You MUST Finish Before August 18
en.summary: Time is running out for PlayStation Plus subscribers to dive into nine fantastic games before they leave the Game Catalog. Don't miss your chance to experience these titles before they're gone!
en.body:
## 1. Dead Island 2
This long-awaited zombie apocalypse adventure finally shambled onto consoles and PC in 2023 after years in development hell. Known for its surprisingly goofy tone, over-the-top gore, and satisfying character buildcrafting, Dead Island 2 offers a compelling blend of intense action and survival horror. If you're looking for a visceral and entertaining experience, now's your last chance.

## 2. Unicorn Overlord
Vanillaware's latest masterpiece is a tactical RPG that blends deep strategic gameplay with stunning, hand-drawn visuals. Its intricate class system and expansive world map offer dozens of hours of engaging content for both newcomers and seasoned strategy fans. The intricate art style alone makes it a must-play before it departs.

## 3. Harold Halibut
Step back into the charm of old-school point-and-click adventures with Harold Halibut. This unique title boasts an absolutely stunning, handcrafted art style developed over years, creating a world and characters that feel truly alive. It's a narrative-driven experience that will resonate with anyone craving a thoughtfully crafted story and distinct aesthetic.

## 4. Earth Defense Force 6
Prepare for relentless alien invasions in this bombastic entry from the beloved Earth Defense Force series. Known for its chaotic, over-the-top action and massive enemy hordes, EDF 6 delivers pure, unadulterated fun. Squad up with friends and defend the planet from extraterrestrial threats before this gem disappears.

## 5. Roki
This enchanting puzzle-adventure game transports players to a beautifully realized Scandinavian-inspired world. Roki combines a compelling narrative with clever environmental puzzles and a touch of folklore. Its atmospheric journey and heartfelt story make it a standout experience for those who appreciate narrative depth and artistic presentation.

## 6. Onee Chanbara Origin
Dive into the stylish, action-packed world of the Onee Chanbara series with this origin story. Featuring dual protagonists and a unique blend of hack-and-slash combat with a distinct anime aesthetic, it's a fast-paced thrill ride. Fans of stylish combat and over-the-top anime action will find a lot to love here.

## 7. Bomber Crew
Take command of a WWII bomber and guide your crew through perilous missions in this strategic simulation game. Bomber Crew challenges players with managing resources, maintaining aircraft integrity, and executing bombing runs under pressure. Its blend of strategy and survival makes for a tense and rewarding experience.

## 8. Space Crew
From the creators of Bomber Crew, Space Crew throws you into the captain's chair of a starship navigating the dangers of deep space. This survival strategy game requires careful crew management and tactical decision-making to overcome alien encounters and environmental hazards. It's a thrilling sci-fi adventure that demands your full attention.

## 9. Clash: Artifacts of Chaos
This action-adventure game offers a unique blend of brawling combat and exploration in a vibrant, cel-shaded world. Players take on the role of a powerful warrior tasked with protecting a young boy. Its distinctive art style and engaging combat mechanics make it a memorable experience for action game enthusiasts.

Bottom Line: Don't let these nine fantastic games vanish from your library – start downloading and playing before August 18th!

content_raw: PlayStation Plus has gotten several new games throughout the month, but as expected, several of them are also set to leave the subscription service's Game Catalog for Extra- and Premium-tier subscribers. In total, there'll be nine games exiting PS Plus on August 18, so you've only got a few weeks left to check out a fun zombie apocalypse adventure, a JRPG with an elegant hand-drawn art style, and one anime-inspired game that knows exactly who its target market is. Here's the full list: PlayStation Plus Game Catalog games leaving on August 18 Bomber Crew (PS4) Clash: Artifacts of Chaos (PS5, PS4) Dead Island 2 (PS5, PS4) Earth Defense Force 6 (PS5, PS4) Harold Halibut (PS5) Onee Chanbara Origin (PS4) Roki (PS5) Space Crew (PS4) Unicorn Overlord (PS5, PS4) Dead Island 2 is the highest-profile exit for next month, and if you haven't checked it out yet, then you've missed out on a fun sequel. Stuck in development hell for several years, it eventually released on PC and consoles in 2023. Surprisingly goofy, extremely violent, and full of a surprising amount of character buildcrafting, it's a fun experience that has a great balance of action and survival. The other game you'll want to check out is Harold Halibut , especially if you've been craving an old-school point-and-click adventure. Harold Halibut wears that influence on its sleeve, and it also looks incredible thanks to the years of work that went into crafting its unique characters and world. While those games won't be around for much longer, you can grab three games right now if you're subscribed to any tier of PlayStation Plus--Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, For the King 2, and CrossCode. For members of PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium, the Game Catalog has already expanded with five games this month, including Rise of the Ronin, Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, and Dying Light. Two more games are arriving on July 28--Sony now does weekly Game Catalog drops for US, UK, and Japanese subscribers--and Premium-tier subscribers can also download two PlayStation Classics next week in the form of Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy and Indigo Prophecy. Next week will also see Sony reveal the next batch of free games for all PlayStation Plus subscribers in August, so don't forget to check in to see what they are ahead of their arrival on August 4.
